patch_description: Crossover of the two lineages: keeps the current program's bidirectional adaptive Kalman fusion (forward + time-reversed pass cancels interior phase error), and grafts in the second program's weak bidirectional Kalman pre-pass (q_base=0.005) so the main adaptive pass sees cleaner innovations, plus the steeper exponential tilt (-1.5) on the final sliding-window convolution to shave lag. The 5-tap running median post-pass is vectorized with sliding_window_view for efficiency, and the impulse-despiking median is also computed vectorized. All stage parameters (despike, SG window 2W+11 with second zero-phase SG pass, slope-consistency snap, trend-lock EMA damping) are preserved from the best-scoring lineage while reducing Python-level loops.
